posts.title: Linear Attention, Visualized
posts.description: In July 2026, Moonshot released Kimi K3 , a 2T-parameter model with a 1M-token context window. K3 uses Moonshot's linear-attention variant, Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). Moonshot reports that it trails only Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol across its evaluation suite.
